body.purpose: Base page type; component copy uses smaller contextual sizes.

motion.name: hero-sequence
motion.purpose: Finite document → connector → hub/ring → result connection → ticket/amount/check sequence. First visible entry once; replay and explicit enabling can repeat it. Documents: 750ms with 210ms stagger; final check ends at 2350+420ms.

motion.name: settle
motion.purpose: Opacity .35 to 1 and translateY(8px) to 0. Feature children stagger 55ms; invoice heading/summary/rows stagger 30ms capped at 120ms. Also comparison, workflow source details, workspace summary and opened FAQ text.

motion.name: interaction-feedback
motion.purpose: Download feedback opacity .4 to 1 over 220ms; review status scale .94 to 1 and opacity .4 to 1 over 260ms.

motion.name: section-entry
motion.purpose: Workflow tracks: 1100ms, 260ms stagger; comparisons: column settle 140ms stagger and 550ms arrow; team rows: 500ms opacity with 100ms stagger; workspace summary settle; pilot border highlight: 900ms.

motion.name: control-transition
motion.purpose: Buttons, tabs, invoice options, FAQ icons and mobile menu bars .2s; team-row background .22s; arrow transforms and navigation underline .25s. Arrows move 3px right, download icons 2px down; pressed buttons 1px down.

motion.name: playback-lifecycle
motion.value: WAAPI active Map with scope visibility and document visibility
motion.purpose: Pause offscreen or hidden-tab animations; resume only visible scopes. Cancel prior animation for a replaced interaction scope and cancel all on motion preference changes. No perpetual loops or scroll polling.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: OS default with page-session explicit override
motion.purpose: Initially follow prefers-reduced-motion. Reduce motion cancels WAAPI, disables CSS animation/transitions, smooth scrolling and replay. Enable motion explicitly opts in for this page, overrides OS reduction and starts the hero. No persistent storage.

motion.name: hero-motion-layout
motion.purpose: Right-aligned caption bottom -10px / -2px; controls bottom -51px / -43px. Control minimum height 36px / 40px. Existing visual tokens and component previews remain unchanged.

narrative.overview:
Margevia adapts the user-selected Nanonets reference through DM Sans, off-white framing, white content surfaces, fine grey borders and violet actions. The atmosphere is calm and precise: generous marketing space leads into a denser, source-backed working sample.

Black square frame markers give the page its structural signature. Small rounded document cards describe the reconciliation story, while primary actions remain rectangular. Product facts and human review remain visible alongside the interface.
keyCharacteristics: Regular-weight headlines with restrained violet emphasis.
Inset hairline framing with black square markers.
White evidence surfaces against warm off-white sections.
Compact tabular figures and explicit review status.
dos: Do keep source evidence and review status adjacent to the amounts they explain.
Do preserve the square action buttons, fine borders and restrained violet emphasis.
Do retain the visible mobile table scroll hint and keyboard-focusable scroll region.
Do use role names as the team section headings.
donts: Don't turn flagged discrepancies into claims of recovered money.
Don't substitute decorative customer logos or unverified social proof.
Don't round every surface into the same card shape.
Don't shrink the invoice table to fit mobile; preserve horizontal scrolling.
